assessment.body:
The 48-hour-old ceasefire is visibly unraveling. Wednesday's euphoric relief rally gave way to Thursday reality check.

IRAN DEPLOYED SEA MINES IN HORMUZ
• Iranian Ports and Maritime Organization (via SNN): ships must use alternate routes due to naval mines
• IRGC Navy published chart showing 'danger zone' in main traffic channel
• Tankers directed to northern route closer to Iranian coast near Larak Island
• Kpler data: only 5 ships transited Wednesday
• MarineTraffic: 400+ tankers, 34 LPG tankers, 19 LNG vessels still clustered in Persian Gulf
• Tankers warned they will be destroyed if they transit without Iranian permission
• Iran Deputy FM Khatibzadeh to BBC: 'You cannot have a cake and eat it at the same time... Iran sent the message crystal-clearly to Washington and to the Oval Office last night'
• UAE Industry Minister Sultan Al Jaber: 'The Strait of Hormuz is NOT open. Access is being restricted, conditioned and controlled'
• A handful of ships have transited since ceasefire: Greek bulker NJ Earth, Liberian bulker Daytona Beach

INDIAN MARKETS: 5-DAY RALLY SNAPPED
• Thursday Apr 9: Sensex fell up to 932 points (1.20%) intraday to 76,629.91
• Nifty 23,760.45 (-236.90 / -0.99%)
• Brent crude REBOUNDED to $97.46 (+2.9 to +4.2%) on ceasefire doubts
• WTI rebounded to $98.38
• HDFC Bank + ICICI Bank alone contributed -250 points to Sensex
• IndiGo fell 4% (gave back part of Wed's +10%)
• Q4 earnings season opens today — Kotak expects just 2.6% YoY Nifty50 profit growth
• Morgan Stanley retained Sensex 95,000 target Dec 2026, calling valuations 'previous troughs'
• Nomura: 'uncertainty elevated, binary risks, recommend balanced portfolios'
• Kotak India strategy: trailing 12-month returns 'almost worst in history'

TCS Q4 — BRIGHT SPOT
• Net profit ₹13,750 cr (+12% YoY)
• Revenue ₹70,698 cr — beat estimates
• Final dividend ₹31 per share (face value Re 1)
• Total FY26 dividend ₹110/share (₹79 interim + ₹31 final)
• TCS stock up 6 consecutive sessions, market cap ₹9.24 lakh cr
• Earnings call 7 PM IST today
• Relief marker ahead of Infosys, HCL, Wipro

TRUMP GOES DARK — 'SHOOTIN STARTS'
• Truth Social: 'All U.S. ships, aircraft and military personnel will remain in place around Iran until a real agreement is reached and fully complied with'
• 'If a deal is not reached, which is highly unlikely, then the Shootin Starts'
• 'Our great Military is Loading Up and Resting, looking forward, actually, to its next Conquest. AMERICA IS BACK'
• War Sec Hegseth on HEU: 'They'll give it to us voluntarily... or if we have to do something else ourselves, we reserve that opportunity'

TALKS PUSHED TO SATURDAY
• White House Leavitt: VP Vance leading US team, first round SATURDAY morning local time (pushed from Friday)
• Witkoff + Kushner on team
• Iran ambassador to Pakistan Reza Amiri Moghadam posted on X Iranian delegation arrives Islamabad tonight 'for serious talks based on 10 points'
• He DELETED the post within an hour
• Vance (in Budapest): Lebanon 'legitimate misunderstanding,' Iran would be 'dumb' to let talks collapse
• Pakistan deployed hundreds of police + paramilitary in Islamabad

BEIRUT: 182 KILLED — UN CONDEMNATION
• Lebanon Health Ministry: 182 killed + 890 wounded in Wed strikes alone
• 5-week Lebanon war total: 1,739 dead + 5,873 wounded
• UN Secretary-General Guterres 'unequivocally condemned'
• IDF killed personal secretary + nephew of Hezbollah deputy chief Naim Qassem
• Mohsen Rezaei (16-year former IRGC commander, new military adviser to Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei): 'We stand with all our might alongside Hezbollah mujahideen, and we will punish the Zionist enemy'
• UN SG, Macron, UK FM Cooper, Australia PM demand Lebanon inclusion
• Macron: Israel's continued occupation 'cannot be a long-term solution'

INDIA — CLOSELY MONITORING, JAISHANKAR TO UAE
• MEA spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal: 'We are closely following the developments in West Asia'
• EAM Jaishankar to visit UAE April 11-12
• Foreign Secretary Misri in Washington meeting senior US officials (defence, trade, West Asia)
• J&K CM Omar Abdullah urged US to 'exert some control over Israel'
• India's structural shields holding:
  1. Only 40% of crude via Hormuz (vs 50%+ EU/Japan)
  2. US 30-day waiver for Russian oil
  3. 6-8 weeks fuel stocks
  4. Reliance 2M barrels Iranian crude direct (Apr 7)
  5. Sea Bird Iranian LPG at Mangalore
  6. 8 of 9 Indian LPG carriers extracted
  7. 51 lakh cylinders delivered Mon, ZERO dry-outs
  8. Rupee at 92.22-92.59 range — strengthened
  9. RBI 5.25% held Wed — has room for cut later if needed

SAUDI EAST-WEST PIPELINE HIT (per Soufan Center)
Soufan Center's intel brief: Iranian missiles hit Saudi Arabia's East-West Crude Oil Pipeline — the pipeline that connects eastern oil fields to Red Sea BYPASSING Hormuz. This is significant because it's one of Saudi Arabia's alternatives to Hormuz. If Iran can hit bypass infrastructure, there are no safe routes. The attacks may stem from IRGC's '31 separate commands mosaic defense architecture' — decentralized units that don't always act in lockstep with political leadership.

NUCLEAR RISK REMAINS FUNDAMENTAL
War Sec Hegseth's 'or we'll do something else ourselves' comment directly echoes CSIS analysis that described any extraction as 'the most complicated special operation in history.' Iran's 460kg of 60% enriched uranium — IAEA's last documented count — remains unaccounted for at the deeply buried Isfahan and Natanz tunnel complexes. Breakout time 'days to weeks.' Trump insists 'no enrichment'; Iran's 10-point plan demands right to enrich. This is the unresolved core that could collapse any deal.

BOTTOM LINE
Day 41 ends with the ceasefire demonstrably fracturing. Iran has now formalized Hormuz closure with sea mines. Only 5 ships transited Wednesday. UAE's own minister says Hormuz isn't open. Sensex snapped its 5-day rally falling as much as 932 points. Brent rebounded to $97.46. Trump warns 'Shootin Starts' if no deal. Talks pushed to Saturday. Israel hasn't stopped bombing Lebanon. Iran's nuclear stockpile remains unaccounted. India is managing the crisis masterfully — Jaishankar to UAE, Reliance buying Iranian crude direct, Forex strengthening, 6-8 weeks fuel stocks — but Indian markets are now adjusting to the reality that Wednesday's euphoric relief rally was one-day bet on peace that is already unraveling.
